item.title: Smithsonian-affiliated museum in Dearborn examines America's post-9/11 response
item.description: A Dearborn museum linked to the Smithsonian has exhibits that argue Arabs faced unfair treatment after the Sept. 11 attacks.

item.title: Buc-Ee's CEO says he'll build only where welcomed, dismissing liberal states
Pollster Allocco tells Newsmax Norman makes S.C. Senate runoff competitive
item.description: Pollster Patrick Allocco said Monday he expects Sen. Darline Graham to defeat Rep. Ralph Norman in Tuesday's South Carolina Republican runoff.

item.title: Giuliani plans to sue Tucker Carlson over Hunter Biden interview
item.description: Rudy Giuliani says he will sue Tucker Carlson, accusing the commentator of defaming him during a recent interview.
